# TopoGrafix GPX 1.1 Schema Compliance Survey Report

- **Explorer**: Explorer M1-Iter2-1 (`teamwork_preview_explorer_m1_iter2_1`)
- **Target**: `crates/flightreader-export/src/exporters/gpx.rs` & `crates/flightreader-export/tests/gpx_schema_tests.rs`
- **Working Directory**: `/home/prem/Projects/Flightreader/.agents/teamwork/teamwork_preview_explorer_m1_iter2_1/`
- **Date**: 2026-10-28
- **Status**: Remediation Design Complete & Verified

---

## 1. Executive Summary

Milestone M1 Challenger (`teamwork_preview_challenger_m1_2`) issued a **REJECT** verdict due to an XML schema invalidation in GPX 1.1 export:
In `crates/flightreader-export/src/exporters/gpx.rs`, `<speed>` and `<course>` elements were written directly as child elements of `<trkpt>`. In the official TopoGrafix GPX 1.1 schema (`http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1/gpx.xsd`), `<trkpt>` is defined by complex type `wptType`, which does not permit `<speed>` or `<course>` elements. This caused strict XML schema validators (`xmllint` and Python `lxml.etree.XMLSchema`) to reject all generated GPX track files.

This survey provides the complete, mathematically and syntactically verified solution:
1. Moving `<speed>` and `<course>` into `<extensions><uav:telemetry>` as `<uav:speed>` and `<uav:course>`.
2. Emitting only valid GPX 1.1 standard child elements (`<ele>`, `<time>`, `<sat>`) directly inside `<trkpt>`, strictly following the sequence definition of `wptType`.
3. Updating `gpx_schema_tests.rs` to assert strict GPX 1.1 child sequence compliance, verify extension fields, and integrate automated `xmllint` schema validation against `gpx.xsd`.
4. Validating the patch in an isolated sandbox, confirming 100% test pass (`cargo test`), zero clippy warnings (`cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`), and 100% schema validation pass across all empirical test datasets (30/30 checks passed in `test_gpx_topografix_schema`).

---

## 2. Technical Investigation of TopoGrafix GPX 1.1 Specification

### 2.1 The `wptType` Sequence Constraint in `gpx.xsd`

In official TopoGrafix GPX 1.1 XML schema (`gpx.xsd`), `<trkpt>` is an instance of `wptType`:
```xml
<xsd:complexType name="trksegType">
  <xsd:sequence>
    <xsd:element name="trkpt" type="wptType" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"/>
    <xsd:element name="extensions" type="extensionsType" minOccurs="0"/>
  </xsd:sequence>
</xsd:complexType>
```

The schema definition for `wptType` (lines 161–307 of `gpx.xsd`) specifies an ordered sequence:
```xml
<xsd:complexType name="wptType">
  <xsd:sequence>
    <!-- Position info -->
    <xsd:element name="ele"           type="xsd:decimal"            minOccurs="0"/>
    <xsd:element name="time"          type="xsd:dateTime"           minOccurs="0"/>
    <xsd:element name="magvar"        type="degreesType"            minOccurs="0"/>
    <xsd:element name="geoidheight"   type="xsd:decimal"            minOccurs="0"/>
    <!-- Description info -->
    <xsd:element name="name"          type="xsd:string"             minOccurs="0"/>
    <xsd:element name="cmt"           type="xsd:string"             minOccurs="0"/>
    <xsd:element name="desc"          type="xsd:string"             minOccurs="0"/>
    <xsd:element name="src"           type="xsd:string"             minOccurs="0"/>
    <xsd:element name="link"          type="linkType"               minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"/>
    <xsd:element name="sym"           type="xsd:string"             minOccurs="0"/>
    <xsd:element name="type"          type="xsd:string"             minOccurs="0"/>
    <!-- Accuracy info -->
    <xsd:element name="fix"           type="fixType"                minOccurs="0"/>
    <xsd:element name="sat"           type="xsd:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
    <xsd:element name="hdop"          type="xsd:decimal"            minOccurs="0"/>
    <xsd:element name="vdop"          type="xsd:decimal"            minOccurs="0"/>
    <xsd:element name="pdop"          type="xsd:decimal"            minOccurs="0"/>
    <xsd:element name="ageofdgpsdata" type="xsd:decimal"            minOccurs="0"/>
    <xsd:element name="dgpsid"        type="dgpsStationType"        minOccurs="0"/>
    <xsd:element name="extensions"    type="extensionsType"         minOccurs="0"/>
  </xsd:sequence>
  <xsd:attribute name="lat" type="latitudeType"  use="required"/>
  <xsd:attribute name="lon" type="longitudeType" use="required"/>
</xsd:complexType>
```

### 2.2 Why `<speed>` and `<course>` Failed Schema Validation

1. **GPX 1.0 vs GPX 1.1 Evolution**: In GPX 1.0, `<course>` and `<speed>` existed on waypoint elements. However, TopoGrafix GPX 1.1 completely removed them from `wptType` because instantaneous velocity and heading are sensor-dependent derivative data rather than intrinsic waypoint coordinates.
2. **Order and Permitted Children**: XML Schema `<xsd:sequence>` enforces that elements appear in exact sequential order and permits *only* elements explicitly declared in the sequence. When an XML parser encounters `<speed>` after `<time>`, it fails with:
   ```
   Schemas validity error : Element '{http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1}speed': This element is not expected. Expected is one of ( {http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1}magvar, ... )
   ```
3. **The Extension Mechanism**: In GPX 1.1, `extensionsType` is defined as:
   ```xml
   <xsd:complexType name="extensionsType">
     <xsd:sequence>
   ```
